name: Westlake Commons
demographics: Westlake Commons attracts health-conscious, affluent residents of Westlake Village and surrounding Conejo Valley communities, typically consisting of upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The primary trade area includes fitness enthusiasts, wellness-focused consumers, and outdoor recreation participants who value organic food options and active lifestyles. Visitors tend to be between 30-55 years old with disposable income for premium dining and specialty fitness services, reflecting the upscale suburban character of Westlake Village.
description: Westlake Commons has established itself as the premier food and fitness destination in Southern California, serving the affluent Westlake Village community with a unique focus on health, wellness, and outdoor lifestyle. This thoughtfully curated center provides a gathering spot for residents seeking healthy dining options, wellness-oriented businesses, and outdoor sports-focused merchants, creating a cohesive lifestyle experience. The center features quality tenants like E+MON Sushi and hosts community events such as the popular Westlake Village Farmers Market, which brings together local vendors and residents in a vibrant outdoor setting. With its emphasis on healthy living and community engagement, Westlake Commons has become more than just a shopping destination—it's a lifestyle hub where health-conscious consumers can find everything from nutritious meals to fitness services in one convenient location. The center's open-air design and carefully selected tenant mix reflect the active, wellness-focused values of the Westlake Village community.
summary: Westlake Commons is Southern California's premier food and fitness lifestyle center, offering health-conscious consumers a curated selection of wellness businesses, healthy dining options, and outdoor sports merchants. The center serves as a community gathering spot in upscale Westlake Village, featuring quality tenants and regular events like the Westlake Village Farmers Market.
